settings.privacy_body: Kajer Manus securely stores your name, email address, mobile number, and service address in our PostgreSQL backend solely to coordinate home service bookings and account notifications. We never sell or share your personal information with unauthorized third parties.
settings.terms_body: Please provide accurate contact details and service addresses when booking on Kajer Manus. We strive to connect you with verified, admin-approved professionals for every appointment.
settings.cancellation_body: Pending or accepted bookings may be cancelled free of charge before work begins. Once work is in progress, please contact support for assistance.
